subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding glob implementation and inter-handler scheduling change as the permanent bootstrap runtime behavior?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but CI cannot decide whether the preserved glob contract and new scheduling interleaving are the desired long-term compatibility boundary for agent context and session behavior.

options.title: Land after exact-head CI
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility and scheduling tradeoffs once all required checks pass on the current head.

options.title: Split hook scheduling
options.body: Land asynchronous file and glob loading separately while moving inter-handler yielding into a narrower follow-up review.

options.title: Require full embedded proof
options.body: Pause until a live embedded run demonstrates channel responsiveness and unchanged bootstrap context under a representative large workspace.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head CI
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded compatibility and scheduling tradeoffs once all required checks pass on the current head.
